t: This Act may be cited as the “Nampa and Meridian Conveyance Act”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act. The tempting reading is that a conveyance act implies dealings with a non-federal irrigation district, but the section itself sets out no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue. No outside party is involved in any federal decision here.
fable.s: This Act may be cited as the “Nampa and Meridian Conveyance Act”.
